dict.string: Aether needs access to Desktop so you can find, review, and move selected large files to Trash.
Aether needs access to Documents so you can find, review, and move selected large files to Trash.
Aether needs access to Downloads so you can find, review, and move selected large files to Trash.
Aether needs access to removable volumes only when you choose to scan files stored there.
Aether needs access to network volumes only when you choose to scan files stored there.
